summary: Join our Nature-Based Solutions for Climate Adaptation training. Learn innovative strategies to combat climate change and promote environmental resilience.
lede: Nature-based solutions for climate adaptation use ecosystems to reduce risks such as flooding, heat, drought, erosion, and water stress. For adaptation professionals and project teams, this course supports planning interventions that fit climate risks and can be implemented, budgeted, and assessed. Learn to screen risks, compare intervention options, assess feasibility and safeguards, and develop costed designs with indicators and clear project justifications.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals across sectors who are responsible for planning and executing climate adaptation projects.
audience: Government staff in environment, water, agriculture, lands
Donor-funded project teams and grant/program officers
Urban planners and county/municipal technical teams
modules: Foundations of Nature-Based Solutions for Adaptation
Site Assessment and Feasibility for NbS Projects
Designing NbS Interventions that Actually Work
Costing and Budgeting for NbS Implementation
Value for Money and Project Justification
Results Frameworks and MEL for NbS
Risk Management and Safeguards in NbS Projects
Climate Finance Readiness and Funding Alignment
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of climate adaptation concepts and some experience in project management or environmental planning.
